name: Mean Reversion - EM Equity Universe + 15% Vol Target
description: Applies short-term contrarian strategy (z-score based allocation, inverse volatility weighting) to the emerging-market equity universe (India, China A-shares, EM IMI ESG screened, UBS Core MSCI EM), capturing mean-reversion opportunities across EM regional dynamics, then scales to 15% annualised volatility. Tests mean-reversion mechanics across a structurally distinct EM volatility and correlation regime.
